Delivered. The Story landed — PR #4 merged to `main`, Story #3 `agent::done`.

## Summary

The task was epic-scope: `/deliver-light`'s suitability gate judged the predicted footprint (4 changed files) over its lite ceiling (2) and, under `--yes`, failed closed to recommending `/plan`. Following that recommendation, I planned it as one cohesive Story (#3) and delivered it through the same single-story engine.

**Terminal envelope: `status: landed`** (PR [#4](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-epic-scope-mandrel-light-cdd9fd96/pull/4), squash-merged, checks green). Gates: validation ✅, base-sync ✅, code-review ✅ (critical 0 / high 0 / medium 0 / 1 suggestion). Acceptance self-eval: `proceed` (6/6 met). The one degraded item — base fast-forward of the main checkout skipped because the working tree is dirty (untracked `temp/`) — is report-only; the merge stands on `origin/main`.

**What shipped** (confined to the API unit + store schema; worker and admin CLI untouched):

- **`POST /projects/:id/shares`** — owner-only, body `{userId, role: "viewer"|"editor"}`, returns `201 {projectId, userId, role}`; re-sharing upserts the role.
- **Migration `0002-project-shares`** — new `project_shares` table (PK `(project_id, user_id)`, `role` CHECK-constrained, both FKs `ON DELETE CASCADE`), added as a forward migration.
- **Uniform access model** via a single store resolver `getProjectForUser` → `owner`/`editor`/`viewer`/none, enforced by `requireProjectAccess`:
  - viewer: reads the project and its tasks; every mutation → `403`.
  - editor: reads + create/update/delete tasks; whole-project delete stays owner-only (`403`).
  - no relationship: `404` everywhere including the shares endpoint — **existence never leaks**; a shared non-owner attempting to share gets `403`.
- **Bad requests → `400`, persisting nothing**: missing/non-integer `userId`, unknown user, unrecognised role, or sharing with the owner.
- **5 new tests** (19/19 pass), typecheck/lint clean. The dead `getOwnedProject` store function was removed as part of the refactor.
